roles.gpt-5.6-terra_primary: Formal primary narrative and production review: causal chain, character intent, emotional beat, shot objective, and prompt clarity.
roles.grok-4.6: High-cognition research review: script comprehension, director-level shot planning, continuity, motives, viewer confusion, cliches, and missing causal bridges. Output is a candidate packet, not a production write.
roles.gpt-5.6-terra_escalation: Arbitrates only material disagreement between Terra and Grok reviews; it does not replace deterministic safety or asset gates.
roles.gpt-5.6-terra_packaging: Formats approved packets and reports; it may not approve, reject, submit provider work, or publish assets.

grok_activation: May execute scoped research work whenever its configured provider channel is available; missing health evidence blocks only formal reliance, not isolated research work. Never fabricate a review.

verdicts.READY: All deterministic gates pass and any required reviewer verdict is supportive.
verdicts.CONDITIONAL: Hard gates pass but an optional reviewer, health receipt, or visual trial remains pending. One bounded test shot may proceed.
verdicts.REWORK: Narrative, continuity, asset assignment, or shot-state problem must be repaired before provider submission.
verdicts.BLOCKED: Missing asset/URL, unsupported renderer feature, unsafe scope, or invalid contract prevents submission.

non_authority: No reviewer may publish a video.
No reviewer may override an invalid asset hash, inaccessible URL, or production_integration=true.
No reviewer output proves a completed provider call or visual quality.
